plan.selection: Reference leave-one-environment-out group Top-1, macro Top-1, MRR, then stable candidate order.
plan.pair_policy: Named pair is a diagnostic only; it never enters feature, parameter, or fusion selection.
plan.folds: Exclude all held query IDs and condition prefixes, then remove held exact text/parsed-sequence duplicates.
plan.aggregation: First stable sample for each query; exactly three challenges. Average classifier scores across replies.
plan.preprocessing: Fit mean/std on fold training only; normalize each block, use weights 1 or .75/.25 or .6/.2/.2.
plan.confidence: Temperature fits reference crossfit scores only. These are conditional library weights, not backend identity probabilities.
plan.limitations: Candidate and blend selection share reference folds; reported CV and calibration contain development selection bias.
